title: 目標達成の後に・拍動、強く

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap has continued to impress, race after race. It's clear as day how talented she really is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting for me. Okay, let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Oguri Cap! She's been doing really well lately!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She's improved so much. It's only a matter of time now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I think people are talking about me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is it? Maybe it's because I've been more confident lately.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've learned a lot through all the races I've been running. Maybe I need to give myself some more credit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So… what race should I enter next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All eyes at the racecourse are on Oguri Cap. Considering her achievements thus far, there's only one place for her to go next.
choice_data_list: Shall we enter a G1 race?
Shall we enter a G1 race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning a G1 race is a surefire route to glory. As such, these races are special to both Umamusume and their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap has really come a long way… I'm sure she can do it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A G1 race… I guess that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, I am… The bigger the race, the more likely it'll be that people back home will hear about me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My driving force is still the same. I just wanna show them that I can come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know that Oguri Cap's supporters back home serve as her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But to win a G1 race, she'll need more than just that. It's important that Oguri Cap think in the long term and set her goals accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to make her set her sights even higher—and I know just how to do that.
choice_data_list: Come on! There's a race we need to go and see!
Come on! There's a race we need to go and see!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What race?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I wonder who's going to take the crown this time. This is so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Yeah, when you voted someone in, it really makes you wanna root for 'em, right?! It's the final showdown of the year, so go get 'em, racers!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wow, everybody's so fired up. So this is the Arima Kinen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen—a race where the competitors are chosen by a fan poll. Some even refer to it as the deciding race of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The hype around this race is second to none. I'm sure some part of it will strike a chord with Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's about to start… That's weird. Why's my heart pounding?
choice_data_list: Make sure to pay close attention.
Make sure to pay close attention.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen winds up being one of the most thrilling ever.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was incredible! Almost made me tear up…

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… She won the Grand Prix! I'm so happy! I'm so glad I chose to support her!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nothing. I just feel… kind of emotional.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I felt a little weepy after going face-to-face with central-level racers for the first time—and after winning my debut race too… But this is something else entirely.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey… Actually, I—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't that Oguri Cap?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're right! It is her! Hey, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I've been watching all your races lately! I'm cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text: Watching you race is always so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text: I'll vote for you for next year's Arima Kinen! I hope you're able to run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Your support means a lot to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing so many words of encouragement from her fans, Oguri Cap seems to have found some new resolve.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Turns out there are even people in the city rooting for me now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want their cheers to propel me on the track. And… I want the folks back home to see me racing here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanna race in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: …So, what's your ultimate goal? What kind of race do you want to run in?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Umm… Well… I…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Oguri Cap has never set her sights on a specific race before, I notice an undeniable sense of determination in her gaze. I know exactly what to suggest.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With next year's Arima Kinen as her goal, Oguri Cap begins her training once again.
